input.reason: splitCharge uses Math.floor for every share, so the remainder cents (e.g. 3333 split 2 ways gives 1666 + 1666 = 3332) are never billed; the fix is to give the leftover cents to some of the shares so they sum to the charge. This touches money, so risk is high, but it is a contained change in src/fees/split.ts outside src/auth/, and no dependency upgrade or protected path is involved.
